create_VQBottleneck: create a VQBottleneck with a given codebook size and vector length for vector quantization
run_VQBottleneck_forward: run the VQBottleneck forward pass on a VqVaeAutoencoderOutput to quantize latent vectors
review_VQBottleneck_quantize_vectors: review the VQBottleneck quantize_vectors method that finds nearest codebook entries by Euclidean distance
test_VQBottleneck_codebook_hits: test the VQBottleneck codebook hit tracking that records how often each codebook entry is used
summarize_VQBottleneck_num_bytes: summarize the VQBottleneck num_bytes calculation that estimates coding cost from codebook size and latent shape
